title: Registry template export
description: Write a standalone copy of the registry template, ready to push as the public template repository (ADR-0025): every file but project.json and local install and build output, the README without its maintainer section and with links into the Ndop repository made absolute, and the workspace's license.

source.description: The registry template folder, relative to the workspace root.

outputPath.description: Folder to write the copy to, relative to the workspace root or absolute. It is emptied first.

license.description: License file to ship as LICENSE, relative to the workspace root.

sourceUrl.description: Base URL of the Ndop repository's files on GitHub, for links that leave the template folder.
